name: EPIC 201691589
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 10.9 solar radii and 1.16 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201691589 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.850994 (16th-84th percentiles 10.50171-11.207234), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201691589 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.159296 (16th-84th percentiles 1.068145-1.256156), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201691589: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4757.9736 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201691589 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4035.46875 (16th-84th percentiles 3941.796875-4131.835938), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.09 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,036 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.16 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,758 K at its surface.
